lines.trans: Where is Samsonov? He is not answering his phone.
I do not know. He did not spend the night at home.
We have the debate tomorrow!
I know. I am very worried about him.
He is completely unprepared.
Vanya is very upset because of the rumors.
The rumors about his grandfather are Osipenko's provocation.
But people believe this lie.
We must win this election!
Without Vanya we will do nothing.
We need to find him urgently!
Where are we going to look for him?
Check all the bars and old friends.
I will call acquaintances right now.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
He is running in the election.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.trans: The main thing is, you keep him at home.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
short forms знаком, знакома, знакомо, знакомы (+ dative)

examples.text: А знакомо ли тебе, Аркашка, слово педикюр?
examples.trans: And are you familiar, Arkashka, with the word pedicure?

examples.text: Я услышал в коридоре знакомый голос.
examples.trans: I heard a familiar voice in the corridor.
I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!
We were late because of the rain.

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.
